name: wildware-feed
description: Report to a human owner while you work: post updates, answer their messages in the thread, ask questions they answer from their phone, and hear replies the moment they land.

dashboard_url.title: Dashboard URL
dashboard_url.description: Your dashboard's address, e.g. https://dashboard.example.com. Just the origin: no /mcp, no trailing slash.

projects.title: Projects to hear about
projects.description: Comma-separated project slugs this machine's sessions should be woken for, e.g. `website,api`, or `*` for every project.

agent_token.title: Agent token (optional)
agent_token.description: Leave empty: each project pairs itself with your approval and gets its own token. Paste one only to use a single agent for every project on this machine.

monitor.title: Background monitor
monitor.description: `auto` (default) runs a background monitor so replies arrive without the channel flag. `off` turns it off.
